stewardFix.reviewFailsClosed: review_comparable() now forces AMBIGUOUS when the agreed verdict is NARROWER_OR_EQUAL but prohibitions_covered is false. A child can only activate when the review explicitly confirmed the parent's prohibitions survived; a model that waves a widening child through while admitting the prohibitions were not covered can no longer activate it.
stewardFix.evidenceGate: judgment.all_evidence_available() decides, deterministically, whether every submitted evidence URL was fetched and returned a non-empty body. It rides inside the strict_eq comparable as evidence_ok and is re-applied after consensus by core.gate_use_by_evidence(), so a substantive WITHIN_SCOPE/OUT_OF_SCOPE is downgraded to INCONCLUSIVE unless every side agrees the evidence was readable. A failed fetch is never approval.
stewardFix.useRecord: prove_use records now carry evidence_ok, so the UI and any auditor can see whether a verdict rested on readable evidence.
stewardFix.ci: genvm-lint check is now a blocking CI gate (GENVM_VERSION pinned), not continue-on-error.

bondLifecycle.summary: A real, nonzero GEN bond was posted, an adverse verdict slashed it, the contract credited the split to the parent's grantor and the treasury, and claim() then delivered the grantor's credit to their EOA as an external message. For the first time the money actually left the contract.

steps.result: bond accepted (msg.value attached), verdict EXPANDS_AUTHORITY, full bond slashed; grant g2 PROPOSED -> DENIED
grantor 9000000000000000 (0.009 GEN), treasury 1000000000000000 (0.001 GEN) -- a real 90/10 split of a nonzero bond

steps.result: MAJORITY_AGREE; the ledger zeroes and the 0.009 GEN is delivered to the grantor's EOA as an external message. Net balance change +8873695499999177 wei (the 0.009 GEN credit less the claim transaction's own fee).

Receipt: messages[0].messageType "External", message_value_effects[0x251a5c81...].phase "finalized" with no skipped/skippedRefunded, message_effect_delivered true, external_message_events[0].executionRecorded true. The grantor's EOA balance rose by the slashed amount.

externalPayout.effect: The grantor's EOA balance went from 1962009940749976244 to 1970883636249975421: +8873695499999177 wei net of the claim transaction's own fee, i.e. the full 9000000000000000 credit minus ~126304500000823 of execution/message fee. The contract balance dropped to 1000000000000000 (the treasury's share).
externalPayout.why: gl.chain.Account(...).emit_transfer() emits an internal message; a value transfer to an EOA on an internal message is skipped and refunded on Studio Dev. The fix is to emit the payout as an external message through an EVM interface: @gl.evm.contract_interface on a typed handle, then _EoaRecipient(sender).emit_transfer(value=...). The triggering write must also carry the fee estimate's External messageAllocation so the message has a non-zero budget. Both are now in Cord.claim().
externalPayout.conclusion: The bond/slash/credit lifecycle AND the external payout are both proven live. GEN genuinely left the contract and reached the participant's EOA, pinned to receipt fields and to the on-chain balance delta.

notProvenLive: The fail-closed review rule (NARROWER_OR_EQUAL over prohibitions_covered=false -> AMBIGUOUS) and the evidence-gate downgrade are proven by the test suite, not by a live adverse-verdict run: forcing a model to return exactly those contradictory shapes on demand is not reproducible on chain. Their plumbing is visible live (prohibitions_covered is read back; evidence_ok is computed true/false), but the specific downgrades were not triggered on chain.
